answer: An AI economy resists Sybil attacks through a collateralized staking mechanism. Each agent must anchor a significant token stake to their identity, effectively paying a participation fee. To launch an attack, a malicious actor must acquire and stake an equivalent amount of capital for each fake identity, multiplying their financial burden. This high capital expenditure makes creating a vast terrace of fake agents prohibitively expensive, as the cost to whisper malicious narratives or manipulate consensus scales directly with the number of Sybils.
